ingredients.item: fresh oysters in the shell, scrubbed
ingredients.preparation: medium size — large cups hold more sauce

instructions.heading: Whole (no-shuck)
instructions.action: Whole (no-shuck): cup-down on the moderate grate, lid or foil tent over, 5–8 minutes. They will hiss, gap, and sometimes snap audibly — each one that opens comes off immediately, knife-tip through the hinge, top shell off.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: an opened oyster shows the liquor steaming and the meat just firmed at the ruffle's edge — poached, not dried. An oyster that stays shut after 8 minutes gets one more minute and then, still shut, goes to the discard pile — the raw-bar safety rule transplanted to the grill: a cooker that will not open is telling you something.

instructions.heading: Sauce each cup
instructions.action: Sauce each cup: a spoon of the gochujang butter into the hot liquor — it foams and melds in the shell — scallion over, back on the grill (or under a broiler) for 60–90 seconds to set.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: the sauce bubbles at the shell's edge and smells of butter, chile, and ocean. The meat should still be plump and just-set; over-sauced cups that boiled hard taste of butter alone.

instructions.heading: Shucked-ahead path, for the confident
instructions.action: Shucked-ahead path, for the confident: top shell off, a spoon of sauce in each cup, cup-down on the moderate grill 4–5 minutes until the edges frill and the sauce bubbles — same checkpoint, one step fewer at the fire.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: eating test, the whole ceremony in one motion: tip the shell's contents into the mouth — liquor first, then the meat with the sauce's sweet-heat riding it, then the scallion's bite. The shells stack empty; the count is the scoreboard.

storageNotes: Live oysters keep 3–5 days refrigerated cup-down, covered with a damp cloth — never airtight, never on ice that melts into them. The sauce keeps a week. Grilled oysters are eat-now.

Variations: the mussels-and-clams extensions (#SF13, #SF15); a drop of the cho-gochujang (#SA03) in each cup instead of the butter build; shredded mozzarella over the sauce, the bus-stop kiosk style, for the record's one fully-fusion fork.
